correctness.rationale: The 4×4 open grid has exactly 36 perfect-matchings; each star meets any matching once. Connected-grid star masks span 15-dimensional cut space in F2^24, giving 512 representatives for the nine chord indices (7,9,11,14,16,18,21,22,23). Independently enumerating all 36 tilings and their distinct nine-bit chord codes reproduced the entire reduced absolute histogram 0:233,4:177,8:72,12:12,16:6,20:2,24:8,32:1,36:1. Therefore 233*2^15=7,634,944 zeros, rank=9,142,272, least nonzero multiplier=4, condition=9. The nine-bit inverse Walsh transform of the nonzero indicator has sum of absolute coefficients=3698, yielding l1=l∞ sharp projection norm 1849/256. Direct edge-inclusion counts 6/12/18 each on eight edges show precisely eight corner-incident singleton Walsh zeros; certificate chord codes, histograms and two source checker approaches inspected. Finite scope is complete exactly at 4×4.
